item.justifylasers.refocusing_cube.input: Five inputs · One output with a double brass rim
item.justifylasers.refocusing_cube.rotat: Sneak + right-click: rotate on the ground
item.justifylasers.refocusing_cube.colle: Sneak + attack: collect · Sprint + attack: stronger kick
message.justifylasers.cube_occupied: Another player is carrying this cube
death.attack.justifylasers.laser: %1$s was cut down by a laser
death.attack.justifylasers.laser.player: %1$s was cut down by a laser while fighting %2$s
gui.justifylasers.light_emission.tooltip: Beam and model-strip emission, colored lighting and reflections while shaders are enabled.
gui.justifylasers.minecraft_lighting.too: Vanilla Minecraft light around the emitter block (level 15). Independent of shader emission.
gui.justifylasers.ignite_entities.toolti: Successful, unblocked hits ignite entities for up to 4 seconds. Adds normal fire damage; fire immunity and fire protection still apply. Requires Entity damage to be enabled.
gui.justifylasers.receiver.strength.tool: Output strength from 0 to 15. Applies to the five sides other than the optical input.
gui.justifylasers.receiver.inverted.tool: Normal: output while a matching laser is detected. Inverted: output when there is no matching laser. The master switch always disables output.
gui.justifylasers.receiver.filter.toolti: Accept any laser color or only the selected color. The model shows the incoming color even when the filter rejects it.
gui.justifylasers.receiver.emission.tool: Shader emission of the receiver's colored indicators while a beam reaches the front. Does not add Minecraft block light.
gui.justifylasers.damage_per_hit.tooltip: 0.1–20 HP per hit, before armor and other defenses. 2 HP = 1 heart. Use the arrow keys for fine adjustment.
gui.justifylasers.knockback.tooltip: 0–10× push per hit. 0× disables knockback; 1× is the original gentle push. Knockback resistance still applies.
gui.justifylasers.hits_per_second.toolti: 1–20 hits per 20 game ticks. 20/s hits every tick; 1/s hits once per second at 20 TPS. Lower server TPS slows the rate.
gui.justifylasers.beam_range.tooltip: 1–512 blocks along the entire beam path, including refocusing cubes. Only loaded chunks are traced. Arrow keys adjust by one block.
